method.method_draft: Model the difference algebraically with signs. Assign + signs to the three balls taken by the player with the larger total, - signs to the three balls taken by the player with the smaller total, and 0 to the four unused balls. The difference is the signed sum of the labels. To maximize this signed sum, place the + signs on the largest labels and the - signs on the smallest labels: +9 +8 +7 -0 -1 -2. This gives 24 - 3 = 21.
